Geometry/lighting unchanged across frames; physical/visual correctness not inferred from timings.

capture.color_management: scene-linear EXR; no AgX/Standard view baked into comparison

comparison.light_units: Emission-only B05: no incident light; glTF factor times emissive strength is passed unchanged to both engines before the shared exposure. Absolute spectral/photometric calibration is unverified.
differences: Cycles stochastic alpha coverage versus Thessa sorted premultiplied alpha-over; B05 has no incident illumination or indirect surface transport
Cycles path sampling/BOX pixel reconstruction versus native raster MSAA=1
Cycles float32 radiance versus Thessa pre-exposed float16 render target
CPU offline Cycles render versus GPU raster; durations are not a performance comparison

metrics.interpretation: Whole-frame diagnostic including AA/silhouette and BRDF differences; no pass threshold or parity claim.

overlap_roi.interpretation: Numeric alpha-over diagnostic. Native accumulates intermediate RGBA16F quantization; Cycles uses stochastic alpha paths. No scene-wide physical/visual acceptance.

native_performance.interpretation: Tiny 3-panel diagnostic; not a coastal or cross-engine performance benchmark. Other jobs may run concurrently.
